'''Veshok Squad''' was an elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] unit, and was part of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were trained by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Kal Skirata]] and near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] they were under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]. They were named after a very hard wood found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Veshok wood/Legends|Veshok wood]].<ref name="Order 66" />
